Students who are considering attending graduate school should talk with an advisor about additional preparatory courses in chemistry, mathematics, and physics. The department very strongly recommends:

Chemistry:

  • CHEM 111, CHEM 112

Math:

  • MATH 120, MATH 121

Physics:

  • PHYS 202A and PHYS 202B or
  • PHYS 204A, PHYS 204B, and PHYS 204C.
